test_title: PYST 80: SSC CGL 2024 - Reasoning (Held On 26 Sept, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Select the combination of letters that when sequentially placed in the blanks of the given series will complete the series.

ABC_FG_JK_MOPQ_TUV_Y
solution:
The logic followed here is:

Given Sequence: ABC_FG_JK_MOPQ_TUV_Y

Now, putting the letters in the blank spaces given in the option one by one:

**Option 1) EHLRW** → ABC__**E**__ / FG__**H**__J / K__**L**__MO / PQ__**R**__T / UV**__W__**Y

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/725c1e883fab8e4ef04ec53998c3e69e9a6a1fecd79be1aaa99fe0b9b484c71f.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1662aa6ac069ee9eb20971f74d80f10db4524724fde17c322ab08d5333b07f73.png] 

Option 2) DHLSX → ABC__D__ / FG__H__J / K__L__MO / PQ__S__T / UV__X__Y

Option 3) DHLRW → ABC__D__ / FG__H__J / K__L__MO / PQ__R__T / UV__W__Y

Option 4) EHLRX → ABC__E__ / FG__H__J / K__L__MO / PQ__R__T / UV__X__Y

Hence, the correct answer is "EHLRW".
